# Dev9b

> Dev9b is an open-source blog article publishing platform by F9XR Team. We share latest articles, tutorials, coding videos, and developer guides for the open developer community.

Dev9b is a free, open-source online community where software developers share knowledge, write technical articles, and help each other grow. Made by developers, for developers.

## Site

- Website: https://f9xr.org/
- GitHub: https://github.com/f9xr/dev9b
- HTML Sitemap: https://f9xr.org/sitemap/
- License: MIT (source), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (content)
- Feeds: RSS (https://f9xr.org/index.xml), RSS (https://f9xr.org/feed.xml), Atom (https://f9xr.org/atom.xml)
